requirements.requirement: Smallest build that holds exactly one bin (minimal parts/footprint)
requirements.evidence: Build has 2 parts: piece:0,0,0;half-n (Hex base · North half) + bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-half-n-full (Bin, half-n full). Quarter bases offer 0 bin sockets (tested quarter-ne/quarter-nw), so a half base is the smallest base that can host a bin. 1 base + 1 bin is the fewest parts possible. Size 191×89×86 mm, 314g. check_build meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Minimal 2-part build: single half-n base with one compatible full-depth bin. Quarter bases cannot hold bins, so this is the smallest viable configuration. Left uncapped/unlocked per house rule for 'smallest build' briefs.
